title: Netomi, which builds AI for enterprise customer service, raised $110M led by Accenture Ventures and signs a deal to bring its platform to Accenture clients (Michael Nuñez/VentureBeat)
summary: Michael Nuñez / VentureBeat: Netomi, which builds AI for enterprise customer service, raised $110M led by Accenture Ventures and signs a deal to bring its platform to Accenture clients — Netomi, the San Francisco-based startup building AI systems for enterprise customer service, said Thursday that it has raised $110 million …
